statement: The period allowed for the directors to deliver a company's annual accounts and reports to the registrar is nine months after the end of the relevant accounting reference period for a private company and six months for a public company.
caveat: A first accounting reference period longer than twelve months and a shortened accounting reference period follow the adjusted deadlines in section 442(3) and (4). Check the company's filing deadline on the Companies House register; the section carries pending 2026 amendments not yet in force.
